cards_resequenced.change: the nightly report gains a fourth thing it must name: a branch of work that was pushed but never turned into a proposed change, so nothing tested it and nothing mentioned it. That happened on 2026-09-01 and you were the one who spotted it, not the machine. No new item was created for it, because this one already exists to make unfinished work impossible to miss and the gap was one query wide.

The two new boxes: switch off the third access grant, which the checklist only covered by implication and would therefore have left switched on, and confirm the live verification below has been done first, because after this day nobody can do it.

It is the only thing standing between four of the nine phase 3 readiness lines and being answered.

NEW. The safety check that guards changes to the live database has one rule frozen to how things looked in August, and any future change to how material is issued out would be refused by it, taking unrelated work down with it. Unfreezing that one rule, without weakening any other.

NEW. Everything still worth keeping from it has been rewritten into this batch, so the old one gets closed off with a note saying where each piece went. This is the second time this has happened and the first one is still open.

all nine re-checked. The score is still 0 of 9 and the reason changed on every single one: the one thing that was failing all nine at once, the database work not being switched on, is done. Four of them now need nothing but a look at the live site. Five still wait on features that have not been built, or on real customer data.

6 of 9, unchanged, nothing flipped. The three that fail were each re-checked and their findings were moved into the field the rulebook actually names, which is where the next reader will look for them. The AI extraction line is two test cases short and has an item for them. The warning email line waits on two settings only you can make. The client acceptance line waits on Mihai and always will.

escalations.title: Two settings for the low-stock warning email have now been put in front of you three nights running and never answered. They are two clicks in the hosting environment and they are the only part of that readiness line anybody but you can move.
escalations.recommendation: Set RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_FROM in the PRODUCTION environment now, by name only, and reply that they are set. RECOMMENDED BECAUSE THEY COST NOTHING AND ARE ON THE CRITICAL PATH ANYWAY: both are already items on the handover checklist, so doing them now removes two items from that day rather than adding any. THE HONEST CAVEAT, REPEATED SO YOU ARE NOT SURPRISED: this does NOT make that readiness line pass on its own. A third thing is needed, a recipient address on a domain that actually exists, and that one lands with the real staff accounts at handover. IF UNANSWERED: nothing breaks. The warning email keeps recording its reason on screen and not sending, which is the designed behaviour, and both settings simply wait to be done on handover day instead.

escalations.title: The live document test with Andre has been waiting on him for six days, and the whole handover now sits behind it: changing the build passwords waits on it, and Mihai's acceptance waits on that. Nothing on either readiness list waits on Andre any more. Only the handover does.
escalations.recommendation: CHASE HIM WITH A DATE, and if he does not answer by it, cut the handover loose from him. Two paths. (a) Ask Andre this week to confirm the agreed format and run one real supplier document through, and if nothing comes back by then, take path (b). (b) Detach the handover from the Andre test entirely, so passwords can be changed and Mihai can be given the system without waiting for him. THE TRADEOFF, STATED PLAINLY: the reason the two were tied together is that a first real document usually finds something that needs a database change, and after the handover no builder can make one without you. That risk is smaller now than when it was written, because every database change so far is switched on and proven, and the extraction path itself is covered by automated checks that run on every change. RECOMMENDED: (a) with a hard date of one week, then (b) automatically. IF UNANSWERED: the handover stays parked behind a third party who has been silent for six days, and Mihai cannot be given the system at all.

escalations.title: The nine things that define phase 3 as ready were written as a proposal on 2026-08-28 and say on their face that you have not approved them. They have now been formally checked against four times by four different sessions, against wording nobody signed off.
escalations.recommendation: APPROVE THE NINE AS WRITTEN, in one reply. RECOMMENDED BECAUSE RE-WORDING THEM NOW THROWS AWAY THE CHECKING HISTORY: four audits have been recorded against these exact sentences, and changing one invalidates its own record. They cover: customers and suppliers as real records, jobs with stages, the two new sections being live, everything linking to everything, material cost per job, budget against actual, estimates compared to what was used, documents and follow-up notes, and the language and layout tidy-up. IF UNANSWERED: they keep being treated as binding in practice, which is what has been happening, and the note saying they are unapproved stays on the board where it will confuse the next reader as it confused this one.
